newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha steady, brushes off crude gains.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha steady, brushes off crude gains.

text.p: NWE naphtha was steady on Wednesday as lax end-user demand cancelled out the bullish effects of stronger crude prices, traders said.
"The main feature of the market today has been that naphtha has remained relatively steady despite crudes gains," one said.
Traders said a pipeline spec cargo out of Grangemouth appeared to still be on the market at an offered price of $201 per tonne cif NWE.
Players said that the seller had been on the verge of selling it at $200 on Tuesday when the sharp gains in crude appeared to have encouraged them to withdraw from the deal.
Offers for the cargo were assessed at $198/$199.
Naphtha swaps for April were assessed at $207.50/$208.50 cif NWE. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
